teaser: The padel shop's path to market: sell one and fulfil it, sell time and trust, promise late, few products, and no stock until orders force it.
core_idea: An early shop should answer two questions before anything else: can you make a sale and fulfil it. What it sells is time, knowledge and trust: an offer takes the problem off the buyer's to-do list whatever the delivery date. So it should be personal and best effort, start with customers who already trust you, promise late and deliver early because broken expectations upset people, offer a few products you vouch for, and hold no stock until orders force it, since stock ties up cash and pays off only after many sales. The first months are a university; host simply on a service that allows a shop.
